UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Authenticated Katalog Yap user account profile, phone/password hash, and Firebase password reset metadata.

userId.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID (matches document ID).

email.description: Account or recovery email used for Google Sign-In and Firebase password reset.

displayName.description: User display name or business contact name.

passwordHash.description: SHA-256 hash of user password for phone+password login.

passwordResetRequestedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds of the last password reset action.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when account record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when account record was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user account document owned strictly by request.auth.uid == userId.
